name: cubrik
tagline: Build, backtest and run AI trading agents on your brokers
description: AI trading agents for Cline, on the brokers and exchanges connected to your cubrik account (Binance, OKX, Hyperliquid, MetaTrader and others). Create, test, start and pause agents (new and copied agents are created paused, and a test places nothing), backtest rule-based ideas on historical candles, read balances, open positions, closed trades, results and Analytics advice, copy ready-made agents from cubrik's Library, and place, change and close orders through each connected platform's own tools. At sign-in you choose what the connection may do: read, manage agents, trade. Broker keys stay in cubrik, and no tool moves money into or out of an account. Comes with cubrik's Intermediate plan and above. Not investment advice.
